guarantees.name: Envelope Encryption (AES-256-GCM + AESWrap)
guarantees.description: Unique DEK generated per document version, wrapped via KMS with KEK versioning; plaintext DEK zeroed immediately.

guarantees.name: Strict Tenant Isolation (Persistence & Memory)
guarantees.description: Tenant identity extracted from validated JWT into request-scoped TenantContext; all queries filtered by tenant_id.

guarantees.name: Cryptographic Additional Authenticated Data (AAD) Binding
guarantees.description: AAD binds ciphertext cryptographically to tenantId|documentId|version, preventing cross-tenant replay.

guarantees.name: Two-Phase Upload State Machine with Atomic Commit
guarantees.description: Upload transitions PENDING -> OBJECT_STORED -> COMMITTED; parent document, outbox, and audit commit atomically.

guarantees.name: Tamper-Evident Audit Hash Chain with Genesis Pointer
Per-Tenant Audit Serialization (Pessimistic Locking)
guarantees.description: Pessimistic lock on tenant prevents audit chain fork or race condition; chain_position strictly monotonic.

guarantees.name: Audit Verification Endpoint with First-Tampered Detection
guarantees.description: POST /api/v1/audit/verify walks chain from genesis and pinpoints the exact first inconsistent event.

guarantees.name: Idempotency via Unique Constraint & Payload Digest
guarantees.description: Mandatory Idempotency-Key; concurrent races handled via unique constraint and DataIntegrityViolation catch.

guarantees.name: Reconciliation & Recovery with Compare-and-Set
guarantees.description: Stale uploads claimed via compare-and-set to RECOVERING; verified digests committed, corrupted/missing marked FAILED and orphaned MinIO objects deleted.

guarantees.name: Transactional Outbox with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
guarantees.description: Outbox events committed atomically with domain mutations; scheduled relay queries with SKIP LOCKED for concurrent worker safety.

guarantees.name: Zero Plaintext & Key Exposure via In-Memory JWT
guarantees.description: JWT tokens kept in memory only (no localStorage/sessionStorage); keys never emitted in API logs or responses.

guarantees.name: Time-Limited and Quota-Enforced Document Sharing
guarantees.description: Access grants support expiration timestamp and remaining download counter decremented atomically.

guarantees.name: Resumable Batch Key Encryption Key (KEK) Rotation
guarantees.description: Unwraps DEK with old KEK, re-wraps with new target KEK without touching ciphertext, advancing cursor batch-by-batch.

guarantees.name: Optimistic Concurrency Control on Policy Modifications
guarantees.description: Policies track version number; concurrent updates detect stale version and return RFC 9457 409 Conflict.

guarantees.name: Encrypted Blind Index Search with Token Intersection
guarantees.description: HMAC-SHA256 blind indexing allows exact keyword search with multi-keyword AND intersection without disclosing plaintext terms.
